  port: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8080</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

spring:
  redis:
    # 从配置文件读取的 Redis 服务器 IP（核心配置）
    host: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">192.168</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1.14</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  # 替换成你的 Redis 服务器 IP
    port: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">6379</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">           # Redis 端口，默认6379
    password: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"abc</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">123</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">           # Redis 密码（无密码则留空）
    database: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">          # 选择的数据库编号，默认0
    timeout: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10000</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">       # 连接超时时间（毫秒）
    # Lettuce 连接池配置（基于 GenericObjectPoolConfig）
    lettuce:
      pool:
        max</span>-active: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    # 最大连接数
        max</span>-idle: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">      # 最大空闲连接数
        min</span>-idle: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">      # 最小空闲连接数
        max</span>-wait: -<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>     # 最大等待时间（-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 表示无限制）

# 必加：打印配置加载日志，确认配置是否被读取
logging:
  level:
    org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.data.redis: DEBUG
    com.example.redis.config: DEBUG</span></span></pre>

<p><span style="font-size: 16px">3.RedisConfig.java</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="font-size: 16px"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">package org.hxl.config;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonAutoDetect;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.PropertyAccessor;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.jsontype.impl.LaissezFaireSubTypeValidator;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration;
import org.springframework.data.redis.connection.RedisConnectionFactory;
import org.springframework.data.redis.core.RedisTemplate;
import org.springframework.data.redis.serializer.Jackson2JsonRedisSerializer;
import org.springframework.data.redis.serializer.StringRedisSerializer;

@Configuration
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> RedisConfig {

    @Bean
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> RedisTemplate&lt;String, Object&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> redisTemplate(RedisConnectionFactory factory) {
        RedisTemplate</span>&lt;String, Object&gt; template = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> RedisTemplate&lt;&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
        template.setConnectionFactory(factory);

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> JSON序列化配置</span>
        Jackson2JsonRedisSerializer&lt;Object&gt; jackson2JsonRedisSerializer = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Jackson2JsonRedisSerializer&lt;&gt;(Object.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        ObjectMapper om </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ObjectMapper();
        om.setVisibility(PropertyAccessor.ALL, JsonAutoDetect.Visibility.ANY);
        om.activateDefaultTyping(LaissezFaireSubTypeValidator.instance, ObjectMapper.DefaultTyping.NON_FINAL);
        jackson2JsonRedisSerializer.setObjectMapper(om);

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> String 序列化</span>
        StringRedisSerializer stringRedisSerializer = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> StringRedisSerializer();

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> key 采用 String 的序列化方式</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        template.setKeySerializer(stringRedisSerializer);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> hash 的 key 也采用 String 的序列化方式</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        template.setHashKeySerializer(stringRedisSerializer);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> value 序列化方式采用 jackson</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        template.setValueSerializer(jackson2JsonRedisSerializer);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> hash 的 value 序列化方式采用 jackson</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        template.setHashValueSerializer(jackson2JsonRedisSerializer);

        template.afterPropertiesSet();
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> template;
    }
}</span></span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px">4.RedisController.java</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="font-size: 16px"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">package org.hxl.controller;

import org.hxl.entity.User;
import org.hxl.service.RedisService;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.</span>*<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;

@RestController
@RequestMapping(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/redis</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
@RequiredArgsConstructor
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> RedisController {

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> final RedisService redisService;

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 设置缓存</span>
    @PostMapping(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/set</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> String <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(@RequestParam String key, @RequestParam String value) {
        redisService.</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(key, value);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">设置成功：key=</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> + key + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">, value=</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> value;
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 设置缓存（带过期时间）</span>
    @PostMapping(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/set/expire</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> String setWithExpire(@RequestParam String key, @RequestParam String value,
                                @RequestParam </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">long</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> timeout) {
        redisService.</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(key, value, timeout, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">设置成功（过期时间</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> + timeout + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">秒）：key=</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> + key + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">, value=</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> value;
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 获取缓存</span>
    @GetMapping(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/get</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> Object <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(@RequestParam String key) {
        Object value </span>= redisService.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(key);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> value == <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span> ? <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">key=</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> + key + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)"> 不存在</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> : <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">获取成功：key=</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> + key + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">, value=</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> value;
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 删除缓存</span>
    @DeleteMapping(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/delete</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> String delete(@RequestParam String key) {
        Boolean result </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> redisService.delete(key);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> result ? <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">删除成功：key=</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> + key : <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">删除失败（key不存在）：key=</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> key;
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 判断key是否存在</span>
    @GetMapping(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/hasKey</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> String hasKey(@RequestParam String key) {
        Boolean result </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> redisService.hasKey(key);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">key=</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> + key + (result ? <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)"> 存在</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> : <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)"> 不存在</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">=========================对象操作==============================
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 1. 存储用户对象（中文测试）</span>
    @PostMapping(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/user/set</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> String setUser() {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 创建带中文的 User 对象</span>
        User user = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> User(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1L</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">张三</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">25</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">北京市朝阳区</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 存储对象，key 设计规范：业务名:id</span>
        redisService.setObject(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">user:1</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, user);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 也可以存储带过期时间的对象（比如 5 分钟过期）
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> redisService.setObject("user:1", user, 5, TimeUnit.MINUTES);</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">用户对象存储成功：</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> user;
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 2. 获取用户对象</span>
    @GetMapping(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/user/get</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> User getUser() {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 读取对象并指定类型为 User.class</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> redisService.getObject(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">user:1</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, User.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 3. 删除用户对象</span>

<p><span style="font-size: 16px">7.App.java</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="font-size: 16px"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">package org.hxl;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*
 * Hello world!
 *
 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

import org.springframework.boot.SpringApplication;
import org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.SpringBootApplication;


@SpringBootApplication
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> App
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> main(String[] args) {
        SpringApplication.run(App.</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, args);
        System.</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">out</span>.println(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">===== Spring Boot 启动成功 =====</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    }
}</span></span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px">8.接口调用</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px">http://localhost:8080/redis/user/set</span></p>
